rule.en: If you need sponsorship, we only apply to employers on the IND register of recognised sponsors and skip jobs that say they can't sponsor.
rule.ar: إذا كنت تحتاج إلى كفالة، نتقدّم فقط لدى أصحاب العمل المسجّلين ككفلاء معترف بهم لدى دائرة الهجرة والتجنيس (IND)، ونتجاوز الوظائف التي تذكر أنها لا تقدّم كفالة.
rule.fr: Si vous avez besoin d'un parrainage, nous postulons uniquement chez les employeurs inscrits au registre des sponsors reconnus de l'IND et écartons les offres qui excluent tout parrainage.

sensitive.notes: Dutch CVs often carry a photo but it is optional and fading (werk.nl's model CV has none), so we allow one but never ask for it. Employers following the NVP Sollicitatiecode ask only job-relevant data, and the Equal Treatment Act (AWGB) and Age Discrimination Act (WGBL) make questions on age, sex, nationality and marital status inappropriate; date of birth and marital status on CVs are outdated. Right to work is asked instead of nationality. Some Dutch forms show an 'Aanhef' (Dhr./Mevr.) salutation; we never require it.

privacy.en: Your data is protected under the GDPR (AVG) and overseen by the Dutch Data Protection Authority.

privacy.fr: Vos données sont protégées par le RGPD (AVG), sous le contrôle de l'Autorité néerlandaise de protection des données.

renewal.en: Your plan renews automatically when it ends. After the first term you can cancel any time with no more than one month's notice, and you have 14 days to withdraw after purchase.

bio.en: Financial Analyst with 8 years in Amsterdam. I lead IFRS and Dutch GAAP reporting, budgeting and forecasting on SAP across business units, and own the monthly close for a 40-person finance team. My Power BI dashboards feed every quarterly business review, and I work in Dutch and English.
bio.ar: محللة مالية بخبرة 8 سنوات في أمستردام. أقود إعداد التقارير وفق المعايير الدولية (IFRS) والمعايير الهولندية (Dutch GAAP)، والموازنات والتوقعات على SAP عبر وحدات الأعمال، وأتولى الإقفال الشهري لفريق مالي من 40 شخصًا. تُعتمد لوحات Power BI التي أعدّها في كل مراجعة ربع سنوية للأعمال، وأعمل باللغتين الهولندية والإنجليزية.
bio.fr: Analyste financière forte de 8 ans d'expérience à Amsterdam. Je pilote le reporting IFRS et Dutch GAAP, le budget et les prévisions sous SAP pour plusieurs business units, et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une équipe finance de 40 personnes. Mes tableaux de bord Power BI alimentent chaque revue trimestrielle, et je travaille en néerlandais et en anglais.

culture.notes: Mon-Fri, 36-40 hour week; part-time and fixed WFH days are common. Statutory employee notice is 1 month and runs to the end of a calendar month unless the contract says otherwise (art. 7:672 BW); contracts can set up to 6 months, and 1-2 months is typical for senior finance roles. Salaries are discussed as gross per month; pay is monthly (often around the 25th) plus an 8% holiday allowance usually paid in May, and some CAOs add a 13th month. CV: 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, photo optional. A short, direct motivation letter (motivatiebrief) is still widely expected. Banks and financial firms usually run pre-employment screening and may ask for a VOG (certificate of conduct). Dutch is required at many domestic employers; Amsterdam multinationals often work in English. Recent graduates and non-EU hires rely on the orientation year and highly skilled migrant schemes.
